summary: Settings-managed embedding model registration, validation, indexing progress, semantic index invalidation, MCP document indexing, and bounded BM25+embedding hybrid search for target 0.11.0-w2.
implied_requirements: Do not hard-code local model-api endpoint, API key, or model name into committed SRS/code/tests.
Settings must remain the owner of long indexing controls; MCP search tools must not expose rebuild, long indexing, model-change, or clear-index controls.
Changing or removing a model must invalidate or remove semantic derived data without making HNSW authoritative over SQLite.
MCP search output limit and internal candidate limits must be separate bounded values.

semantic_equivalences.canonical_term: optional API key or bearer token credential

recommended_req_split: APP functional requirement for Settings embedding status and registration UI
DOC functional requirement for registration-triggered indexing, progress, and semantic invalidation
DOC functional requirement for bounded hybrid BM25+embedding ranking
MCP interface update superseding smart_search v1 limit default 10 with default 20
MCP constraint update superseding seven-tool parity dependency on the old smart_search contract
